name: 4-Way Neck Machine
instructions: Sit in the neck machine and set your head against the pad facing the direction you want to train.
Move your head slowly against the resistance through a comfortable range.
Return under control, then turn to train the front, back and both sides.

name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your front leg bent 90 degrees in front and your back leg bent 90 degrees to the side.
Sit tall and lean forward over your front shin.
Hold, then rotate your knees to the other side and repeat.

name: A-Skip
instructions: Skip forward, driving one knee up to hip height.
Snap that foot back down under your hip as the other knee comes up.
Swing your arms in rhythm and stay tall.

name: Ab Coaster
instructions: Kneel on the carriage of the ab coaster and hold the handles.
Pull your knees up toward your chest by curling your hips.
Lower back down slowly.

name: Ab Crunch (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Sit in the plate-loaded ab machine and grab the handles or chest pads.
Crunch forward, curling your ribs toward your hips.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch.

name: Agility Ladder Drills
instructions: Lay an agility ladder flat on the floor.
Move through it with quick foot patterns such as one foot in each box, two feet in, or in-in-out-out.
Stay on the balls of your feet and pump your arms.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with your arms straight.
Lower one dumbbell to your chest while the other stays locked out.
Press it back up, then repeat with the other arm.

name: Alternating V-Up
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift one straight leg and your upper body, reaching your hands toward that foot.
Lower and repeat with the other leg.

name: American Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and hinge to swing it back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward hard and keep the swing going past chest height.
Finish with the bell directly overhead, arms locked and ribs down.
Control it back down into the next swing.

name: Arc Trainer
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Push through your feet in a smooth arcing stride.
Adjust the incline and resistance to set your effort, and keep a steady pace.

name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with a very wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
Lower under control and alternate sides each rep.

name: Arm Ergometer
instructions: Sit or stand facing the machine and grab both handles.
Turn the handles in smooth circles like pedaling a bike with your arms.
Set the resistance and keep a steady pace for the set time.

name: Assisted Chin-Up
instructions: Set the counterweight and kneel or stand on the platform of the assisted pull-up machine.
Grab the close handles with your palms facing you.
Pull your chin above your hands, then lower under control.

name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
instructions: Set up for a barbell hip thrust and move one foot slightly forward onto its heel.
Drive mainly through the back foot to raise your hips.
Squeeze at the top and lower.

name: Back Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings and tuck your legs through your arms.
Lower your body behind you until it is flat and face down.
Hold with straight arms, then pull back out the way you came in.

name: Backstroke
instructions: Float on your back with your body flat and your face up.
Reach one arm overhead into the water and pull it down to your hip, then the other.
Keep a small, steady flutter kick from your hips.

name: Ball Adductor Squeeze
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball as hard as you can.
Hold and release.

name: Band Bent-Over Row
instructions: Stand on a band with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward at the hips.
Hold the band with arms hanging straight.
Row your hands toward your stomach, then lower under control.

name: Band Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the ends with palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl your hands to your shoulders.
Lower slowly against the band.

name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step forward until there is tension, with your hands beside your chest.
Press your hands forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

name: Band Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and grab both ends.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, hands near your shins.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then lower slowly.

name: Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold it with both hands, arms straight.
Pull the band toward your face, spreading your hands and driving your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Band Finger Extension
instructions: Loop a small rubber band around your fingers and thumb.
Spread your fingers apart against the band.
Return slowly and repeat.

name: Band Front Raise
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handles in front of your thighs.
Raise your arms straight forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band's pull.

name: Band Glute Kickback
instructions: On all fours, loop a band around your feet.
Kick one leg back and up.
Return slowly.

name: Band Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand on a resistance band holding the ends with palms facing each other.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, keeping elbows still.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit against a bench with a band stretched across your hips and anchored at both sides.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes and lower slowly.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band high above you and kneel or sit facing it.
Hold the band with arms extended overhead.
Pull your elbows down to your sides, then let your arms return slowly.

name: Band Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Anchor a band low and loop it around your ankles while lying face down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Neck Extension
instructions: Loop a light band around the back of your head and anchor it in front of you.
Sit or stand tall and tilt your head back against the band.
Return slowly to neutral.

name: Band Pallof Press
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on to it, holding it at your chest.
Press the band straight out in front of you and resist being twisted.
Hold briefly, bring it back, then switch sides.

name: Band Push-Up
instructions: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold an end under each hand.
Get into a push-up position and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up against the band until your arms are straight.

name: Band Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the ends with palms facing down.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl your hands up to your shoulders.
Lower slowly.

name: Band Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your thighs.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand up against the band.

name: Band Seated Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit on a bench with a mini band just above your knees.
Push your knees out against the band.
Return slowly.

name: Band Seated Row
instructions: Sit with legs straight and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with arms extended and sit tall.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

name: Band Shoulder Pass-Through
instructions: Hold a band or stick in front of your hips with a wide grip.
Keeping your arms straight, lift it over your head and behind your back.
Bring it back to the front and repeat slowly, narrowing your grip over time.

name: Band Shrug
instructions: Stand on a resistance band and hold the ends at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.

name: Band Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles and stand tall.
Lift one leg out to the side.
Return slowly.

name: Band Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a band high and stand facing it, holding it with straight arms in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the band down until your hands reach your thighs.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Band Triceps Kickback
instructions: Stand on a resistance band, hinge forward at the hips and hold the band with your upper arm tucked to your side.
Extend your elbow to push your hand back until your arm is straight.
Return slowly without moving your upper arm.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band high, such as over a door or pull-up bar, and grab it with both hands.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and push your hands down until your arms are straight.
Let your forearms rise back up slowly.

name: Band Woodchop
instructions: Anchor a band high and stand side-on to it, holding it with both hands.
Pull diagonally down across your body, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly and switch sides.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a mini band above your knees.
Press your knees out against the band and lift your hips.
Hold briefly at the top and lower.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and rest your rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
aliases: barbell rear foot elevated split squat

name: Barbell Cheat Curl
instructions: Hold a heavy barbell with an underhand grip.
Use a small hip swing to start the curl, then finish it with your biceps.
Lower the bar slowly with strict control.

name: Barbell Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, lowering into a lunge.
Return to standing and repeat.

name: Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand, shoulder-width grip in front of your thighs.
Keeping your arms nearly straight, raise the bar to eye level.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.

name: Barbell High Pull
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Dip slightly, then explosively extend your hips and pull the bar to chest height with elbows high.
Lower the bar back to your thighs and reset.

name: Barbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs and shift your weight onto one leg.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing the glute of the standing leg.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a straight barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to raise the bar back to the start.

name: Barbell Split Squat
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and take a long split stance.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up through your front foot.

name: Barbell Static Hold
instructions: Set a loaded barbell in a rack at thigh height.
Grip it overhand, stand up with it, and hold it at arm's length.
Hold for time, then set it back down.

name: Barbell Sumo Squat
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Push your knees out and sit straight down between your legs.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Basketball
instructions: Warm up with light jogging and some shooting.
Play a full or half-court game, or run drills like layups and sprints.
Take breaks between games and drink water.

name: Battle Rope Slams
instructions: Hold one rope end in each hand in a half squat.
Lift both arms overhead together.
Slam the ropes down as hard as you can, bending your knees with the slam.
Repeat quickly for the set time.

name: Bear Crawl
instructions: Get on hands and toes with your knees hovering just off the ground.
Move forward by stepping the opposite hand and foot together.
Keep your back flat and hips low.

name: Bear Plank
instructions: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Hold with a flat back.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside a low pulley and reach behind your back with the far hand to grab the handle.
Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly back behind your hips, then switch sides.

name: Body Saw
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your feet on sliders or towels.
Push your body back with your forearms so your shoulders move past your elbows.
Pull back to the start without letting your hips drop.

name: Bodyweight Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and place the top of your rear foot on it.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot to return up.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step or the floor.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly.

name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and feet flat.
Drive your hips up until your body is in a line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Take a big step to the side and sit back into that hip, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off to return to the start.

name: Bodyweight Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return and switch legs.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench.
Step up with one foot and drive through it to stand on top.
Step back down and repeat.

name: Breaststroke
instructions: Float face down with arms stretched in front of you.
Sweep your hands out and back, then bring them together under your chest.
Kick your legs out and together like a frog as you glide forward.
Breathe in each time your head lifts at the end of the pull.

name: Burpee Box Jump
instructions: Stand facing a box.
Do a burpee, bringing your chest to the floor and jumping your feet back in.
Jump onto the box, stand tall, then step down and repeat.

name: Burpee Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar.
Do a burpee: drop to the floor, chest to the ground, then jump your feet back in.
Jump up to grab the bar and do one pull-up.
Drop down and repeat.

name: Bus Driver
instructions: Hold a weight plate at the sides with arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
Rotate the plate left and right like turning a steering wheel.
Keep your arms up the whole set.

name: Butterfly Sit-Up
instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Lie back until your hands touch the floor behind your head.
Sit up and reach forward to touch your feet.

name: Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with the soles of your feet pressed together.
Hold your feet and let your knees drop toward the floor.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, gently pressing your knees down with your elbows if needed.

name: Cable Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench next to a low cable with a single handle.
Brace your elbow against your inner thigh and curl the handle up.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

name: Cable Cross-Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope or single handle to a low cable and stand side-on to it.
With palm facing in, curl the handle up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching arms.

name: Cable Cross-Body Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys and grab the opposite handles so the cables cross in front of you.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly until your hands cross in front of your hips.

name: Cable Goblet Squat
instructions: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it at your chest while facing the machine.
Step back so the cable is taut and squat down between your knees.
Stand back up, keeping your chest tall.

name: Cable Oblique Crunch
instructions: Stand side-on to a high pulley holding a handle beside your head.
Crunch down and to the side toward the machine.
Return slowly and switch sides.

name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low cable and hold it with palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with wrists over the edge.
Lift the backs of your hands up, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
With soft knees, hinge at the hips and let the handle travel toward your shins.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to your outside leg.
Lift the leg out to the side.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and face the machine.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
instructions: Stand on a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads and back against the backrest.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they are level with your hips.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip about shoulder-width.
Pull hard until your chest touches the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower all the way down to a full hang.

name: Chin Tucks
instructions: Sit or stand tall looking straight ahead.
Pull your chin straight back as if making a double chin.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then relax.

name: Close-Grip Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
similarTo: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip

name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press your chest up while keeping your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.

name: Commando Pull-Up
instructions: Stand sideways under the bar and grab it with both hands close together, one in front of the other.
Pull up, bringing your head to one side of the bar.
Lower under control and alternate sides each rep.

name: Crab Walk
instructions: Sit down with your feet flat and hands behind you, fingers forward.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Walk forward or backward on your hands and feet, keeping your hips up.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height or higher and cross the cables, holding each one in the opposite hand.
Keep your elbows up and extend your arms out to the sides until they are straight.
Return slowly back across your body.

name: Cross-Body Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell straight above your shoulder.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Straighten your arm to return and finish all reps before switching sides.
similarTo: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension

name: Cross-Body Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Drive your right knee toward your left elbow, then switch.
Move quickly while keeping your hips low and level.

name: Crow Pose
instructions: Squat down and put your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms.
Lean forward until your feet lift off the floor and hold.

name: Curved Treadmill Run
instructions: Step onto the curved belt and hold the rails to start.
Move toward the front of the curve to speed up and drift back to slow down.
Run tall with quick steps on the balls of your feet.

name: Decline Bench Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on a decline bench, head at the top, holding the bench behind your head.
Raise your straight legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower slowly until they are just above the bench.

name: Decline Cable Chest Press
instructions: Set a decline bench between two cable stations with the pulleys low and grab a handle in each hand.
Start with the handles beside your chest and press them up and together over your lower chest.
Lower the handles back under control.

name: Decline Chest Press Machine (Pin-Loaded)
instructions: Sit in the machine and set the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Press the handles forward and down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

name: Decline Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and grip the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked.
Press the bar back up to lockout.

name: Decline Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on a decline bench with your feet hooked and lean back partway.
Holding a weight at your chest, rotate your torso side to side.
Keep your lower back neutral.

name: Dive Bomber Push-Up
instructions: Start in a pike position with your hips high and hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and dive your chest forward and down just above the floor, ending with your arms straight and chest up.
Reverse the motion back to the pike position.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on the frame with your elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
similarTo: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch

name: Double Kettlebell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent, holding a kettlebell in each hand at chest level with the bells resting on your forearms.
Press both kettlebells straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower them until your elbows touch the floor.

name: Double Unders
instructions: Hold a speed rope and start with a few regular jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope fast with your wrists so it passes under your feet twice.
Land softly and keep your arms close to your sides.

name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your hips up and back so your body makes an upside-down V.
Press your heels toward the floor and your chest toward your legs, then hold.

name: Dumbbell Curl to Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders, then press them overhead.
Reverse the motion to return to the start.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the dumbbells to mid-shin, back flat.
Stand back up by driving through your feet.

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl the weights up while sliding them along your body and pulling your elbows back.
Lower slowly along the same path.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides until your upper arms touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with one end resting on each shoulder.
Keep your elbows up and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell on your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

name: Dumbbell High Pull
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge slightly, then drive your hips forward and pull the dumbbells up, elbows high and wide.
Bring them to chest height, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Internal Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side on the arm you will work, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked by your side.
Holding a light dumbbell, rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower slowly back toward the floor.

name: Dumbbell JM Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing your feet.
Bend your elbows and bring the dumbbells down toward your shoulders, letting your elbows travel slightly forward.
Press the dumbbells back up by straightening your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with a dumbbell held between your feet.
Curl the dumbbell toward your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up hard with your legs.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead, then lower them to your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Push-Up
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles in a push-up position.
Lower your chest between the dumbbells, going deeper than a normal push-up.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hinge forward holding dumbbells with your arms hanging and palms facing back.
Row the dumbbells up with your elbows flared out wide toward the ceiling.
Squeeze the backs of your shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
instructions: Get into a high plank holding a dumbbell in each hand, feet wide.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without rotating your hips.
Lower it and alternate arms.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows and let your upper arms drift back so the dumbbells come down beside your head.
Roll your upper arms forward and press the dumbbells back up over your chest.

name: Dumbbell Seal Row
instructions: Lie face down on a raised flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row the dumbbells up toward your hips while keeping your chest on the bench.
Lower the weights until your arms are fully straight.

name: Dumbbell Step-Down
instructions: Stand on a low box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Slowly lower one heel toward the floor by bending the standing leg.
Tap lightly and push back up with the leg on the box.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes out and hold one dumbbell between your legs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbell toward the floor.
Drive through your feet and stand up tall.

name: Dumbbell Woodchop
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with both hands above one shoulder.
Swing it down across your body to the outside of the opposite knee while rotating.
Lift it back up under control and switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight in front of you, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit tall and press the dumbbells straight overhead without leaning back.
Lower them back to your shoulders under control.

name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
instructions: Hold an EZ bar at your thighs with a narrow overhand grip.
Pull the bar up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips high in a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Exercise Ball Pike
instructions: Get into a push-up position with your shins on a stability ball.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, rolling the ball to your toes.
Lower slowly back to the plank.
similarTo: Push-Ups With Feet On An Exercise Ball

name: Exercise Ball Plank
instructions: Place your forearms on a stability ball and walk your feet back into a plank.
Brace your abs to stop the ball from rolling.
Hold for time.

name: Exercise Ball Rollout
instructions: Kneel with your forearms on a stability ball.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body into a long line.
Pull it back with your abs.

name: Exercise Ball V-Up Pass
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stability ball overhead.
Lift your arms and legs together and pass the ball to your feet.
Lower, then lift again and pass it back to your hands.

name: Fast Feet
instructions: Get in a low athletic stance on the balls of your feet.
Pitter-patter your feet as fast as you can in place.
Keep your chest up and arms ready.

name: Feet-Elevated Bench Dip
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a bench behind you and rest your heels on a second bench in front.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Feet-Elevated Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at hip height and rest your heels on a bench or box.
Hang beneath the bar with a straight body.
Pull your chest to the bar and lower with control.

name: Feet-Up Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and lift your feet off the floor, knees bent or legs straight.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid-chest while keeping your body steady.
Press the bar back up to lockout without using leg drive.

name: Flat Bench Cable Chest Press
instructions: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight above your chest.
Lower them slowly back to chest level.

name: Flexed-Arm Hang
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an underhand or overhand grip and jump or pull to the top position.
Hold your chin above the bar for as long as you can.
Lower slowly when you can no longer hold the position.

name: Floor Triceps Dip
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands to lift your hips off the floor.
Bend and straighten your elbows to lower and raise your body.

name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
instructions: Lie back with a foam roller across your upper back and hands behind your head.
Keep your hips on the floor and gently arch back over the roller.
Move the roller up or down a little and repeat.

name: Forearm-SMR
instructions: Rest your forearm on a foam roller or ball on a table or the floor.
Press down and roll slowly from wrist to elbow.
Pause on tight spots, then switch arms.

name: Frog Stretch
instructions: Get on hands and knees and slide your knees out wide.
Turn your feet out so your ankles line up with your knees.
Rock your hips back slowly until you feel a stretch in your inner thighs and hold.

name: Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and lift your body until it is flat and parallel to the floor, face up.
Hold, or start with knees tucked to make it easier.

name: GHD Sit-Up
instructions: Sit on a glute-ham developer with your feet locked in and thighs on the pad.
Lean back under control until your torso is parallel or below.
Drive your legs and abs to sit back up.

name: Glute-Focused Back Extension
instructions: Set up on a 45-degree back extension bench with the pad below your hips.
Round your upper back slightly and lower your torso.
Squeeze your glutes to lift back up until your body is in a straight line.

name: Gorilla Row
instructions: Stand in a wide stance with two kettlebells between your feet and hinge forward.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while pressing the other into the floor.
Lower it and alternate sides each rep.

name: Hack Squat Calf Raise
instructions: Stand in the hack squat machine with the balls of your feet at the edge of the platform.
Keep your knees straight and lower your heels.
Rise onto your toes.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
instructions: Kneel on one knee side-on to a high pulley with the outside knee up.
Pull the handle down and across your body toward your outside hip.
Return slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Hand Gripper
instructions: Hold a hand gripper in one hand with the handles in your palm and fingers.
Squeeze until the handles touch.
Release slowly and repeat, then switch hands.

name: Hand-Release Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position and lower your chest all the way to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor for a moment.
Place them back and push up to full arm extension.

name: Hang Power Clean
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at your thighs with an overhand grip just outside your legs.
Hinge slightly so the bar slides to just above your knees.
Jump hard through your legs, shrug and pull your elbows high.
Drop slightly under the bar and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat, then stand.

name: Hang Power Snatch
instructions: Hold a barbell at your thighs with a wide snatch grip.
Hinge so the bar sits just above your knees, keeping your back flat.
Explode up through your legs and pull the bar close to your body.
Punch under it and catch it overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat, then stand.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Raise your knees up and toward one side, turning your hips.
Lower slowly and alternate sides.

name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
instructions: Hang from a bar and raise your straight legs to the top.
Rotate your legs side to side like windshield wipers.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.

name: Happy Baby
instructions: Lie on your back and pull your knees toward your armpits.
Grab the outsides of your feet with your shins pointing up.
Gently pull down and rock side to side while you breathe.

name: Heavy Bag Punching
instructions: Wrap your hands and put on gloves, then stand in a boxing stance near the bag.
Throw jabs, crosses, hooks and uppercuts in combinations.
Move around the bag and work in rounds with short rests.

name: Heel-Elevated Barbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your heels on a small plate or wedge and a barbell on your upper back.
Squat straight down, letting your knees travel forward over your toes.
Stand back up by driving through the balls of your feet and heels.

name: High Knees
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Run in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.

name: High Row (Pin-Loaded)
instructions: Sit at the selectorized high row machine and set the pin for your weight.
Grab the handles above and in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back toward your chest, then return slowly.

name: Hill Sprints
instructions: Find a moderate hill and warm up with easy jogging.
Sprint up the hill for 10 to 30 seconds with a strong arm drive.
Walk back down to recover and repeat.

name: Hindu Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hips high and hands and feet on the floor.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Finish with your arms straight and chest lifted, then push your hips back up to the start.

name: Hollow Body Rock
instructions: Get into a hollow hold with arms overhead and legs straight off the floor.
Rock back and forth while keeping the same rigid shape.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.

name: Incline Cable Curl
instructions: Set an incline bench in front of a low cable and lie back holding two handles.
Let your arms hang straight down behind your body line.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, then lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight, then pull your shoulder blades up and together.
Hold briefly and lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding two dumbbells together over your upper chest, palms facing each other.
Squeeze the dumbbells hard against each other.
Lower them to your chest and press back up while keeping them pressed together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells above your head with your palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend your elbows to return to the start.

name: Incline Dumbbell W Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells and elbows bent.
Pull your elbows back and rotate your hands up so your arms form a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.

name: Jacob's Ladder
instructions: Step onto the slanted ladder and put on the belt if your machine has one.
Climb the rungs with hands and feet, keeping your hips near the belt.
Speed up to make the ladder move faster, and slow down to ease off.

name: Jumping Pull-Up
instructions: Stand under a bar that you can reach with a small jump, gripping it overhand.
Jump and use the momentum to help pull your chin over the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back to the floor.

name: Kettlebell Around the Body Pass
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in one hand at hip height.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around the front and switch hands again, making circles around your waist.
Do your reps, then switch direction.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Carry
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle hard to keep the bell balanced.
Walk slowly for the set distance, then switch hands.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms-Up Press
instructions: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height, bell pointing up.
Grip hard and brace your core to keep the bell balanced.
Press it straight overhead without letting it tip, then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and rest your rear foot on a bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot to stand.

name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand and stand on a step.
Lower your heels.
Rise onto your toes.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
instructions: Start with a kettlebell between your feet and grab it with one hand.
Hinge and pull it up to the rack position at your shoulder, letting it roll around your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower to the rack, then back between your legs, and repeat.
aliases: single arm kettlebell clean and press

name: Kettlebell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand, or one bell by the horns with both hands.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the weight up to your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet about hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grab the handle with both hands, back flat.
Stand up tall, then lower the bell back to the floor.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Carry
instructions: Clean one or two kettlebells up to the rack position at your shoulders.
Keep your elbows tucked and stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with short, steady steps for the set distance or time.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
instructions: Clean one kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder.
Brace your core and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Stand back up without leaning toward the weight.

name: Kettlebell Front Raise
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands in front of your hips.
Raise it forward with nearly straight arms until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Kettlebell Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand with palms facing in.
Curl the bells up without letting your elbows move forward.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit against a bench and hold a kettlebell on your hips.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes and lower.

name: Kettlebell Pullover
instructions: Lie on a bench or the floor holding a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the kettlebell back behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand or one at your chest.
Step back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.

name: Kettlebell Shrug
instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up as high as possible.
Pause, then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with your arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend your elbows to raise it back up.

name: Kettlebell Step-Up
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand in front of a box.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up to standing.
Step down with control and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
instructions: Hold one kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of your thighs.
Pull it up toward your chin, keeping your elbows above your hands.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Kettlebell Waiter's Walk
instructions: Press a kettlebell overhead with one arm and lock your elbow.
Keep your wrist straight and your ribs pulled down.
Walk slowly for the set distance, then switch arms.

name: Kipping Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and swing your body into an arch, then a hollow position.
Use the hip drive from the swing to pull your chin over the bar.
Push away from the bar and flow straight into the next swing.

name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width and your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall in a split stance with your front toes a few inches from it.
Bend your front knee forward to touch the wall without lifting your heel.
Move your foot back a little as you get more flexible, then switch legs.

name: Kneeling Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Kneel and place your hands close together under your chest so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond.
Keeping your body straight from knees to head, lower your chest to your hands.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Knuckle Push-Up
instructions: Make fists and set up in a push-up position resting on your knuckles with your wrists straight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Sit between parallettes, dip bars or on the floor with hands by your hips.
Press down to lift your body off the ground.
Hold your legs straight out in front at hip height for as long as you can.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar and raise your straight legs until they are level with your hips.
Hold the L position as you pull your chin over the bar.
Lower to a full hang while keeping your legs up.

name: Landmine Hack Squat
instructions: Load the free end of a landmine bar and stand facing away from the anchor with the sleeve on one shoulder.
Lean slightly back into the bar and squat down.
Drive up through your feet to stand.

name: Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a landmine and grab the end of the bar with your far hand, arm across your body.
Raise the bar out and up in an arc until your arm is at shoulder height.
Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching sides.

name: Landmine Split Squat
instructions: Hold the end of a loaded landmine bar at your chest in a split stance.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive up through your front foot.

name: Landmine Squeeze Press
instructions: Load one end of a barbell anchored in a landmine and stand facing it.
Hold the sleeve at chest height with both palms pressed together around it.
Squeeze your hands together and press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight, then lower it back to your chest.

name: Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Get in a low athletic stance with knees bent.
Shuffle sideways quickly without letting your feet touch.
Go a set distance, then shuffle back the other way.

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
instructions: Sit tall and turn your head about 45 degrees to one side.
Drop your nose toward your armpit and gently pull with the same-side hand.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch sides.

name: Lizard Pose
instructions: Step one foot forward into a lunge, outside of your hands.
Lower your back knee to the floor.
Sink your hips down and forward, or drop to your forearms for a deeper stretch, then hold and switch.

name: Low Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline of about 15 to 30 degrees and lie back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.

name: Lu Raise
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides with thumbs up.
Raise your arms out to the sides with straight elbows until they pass shoulder height.
Keep lifting in a wide arc until the dumbbells are nearly overhead.
Lower slowly along the same path.

name: Man Maker
instructions: Start in a plank holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Do a push-up, then row each dumbbell once.
Jump your feet to your hands, clean the dumbbells to your shoulders and stand.
Press them overhead, then lower and repeat.

name: Marching Glute Bridge
instructions: Lift into a glute bridge.
Keeping your hips level, lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it and alternate legs.

name: Medicine Ball Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with one hand on a medicine ball and the other on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor and push back up.
Switch the ball to the other hand between reps or sets.
aliases: one hand medicine ball push up

name: Medicine Ball Sit-Up Throw
instructions: Lie on your back facing a partner or wall, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Sit up explosively and throw the ball forward.
Catch it and lower back down under control.

name: Muscle Clean
instructions: Start with a barbell on the floor and grab it with a clean grip.
Lift it as in a clean, keeping it close to your body.
Without dipping your knees, pull the bar up and turn your elbows forward to catch it on your shoulders.
Lower it back down and repeat.

name: Neck Harness Extension
instructions: Put on a neck harness with weight hanging and stand bent forward with hands on your knees.
Let your head drop forward slowly.
Lift your head back up until your face points forward.

name: Neck Rolls
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Drop your chin to your chest and slowly roll your head to one side, then the other.
Keep the movement slow and gentle, then switch directions.

name: Negative Push-Up
instructions: Start at the top of a push-up with your arms straight and body in a line.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, taking three to five seconds to reach the floor.
Drop to your knees to get back up and repeat.

name: One-Arm Kettlebell Overhead Press
instructions: Clean a kettlebell to the rack position at your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell straight overhead until your arm locks out.
Lower it back to the rack and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Open Book Stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms straight out in front, palms together.
Keeping your knees together, open your top arm across your body toward the floor behind you.
Follow your hand with your eyes, pause, then return and repeat.

name: Paused Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and unrack the bar with a grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest and hold it there motionless for one to two seconds.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension without bouncing.

name: Paused Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a normal deadlift and lift the bar just off the floor.
Pause for one to two seconds just below the knees.
Finish the lift, then lower and reset for the next rep.

name: Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg held straight out in front.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as you can, reaching your arms forward.
Drive back up to standing without letting the other foot touch.

name: Plank Hip Dips
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Rotate your hips to dip one side toward the floor, then the other.
Keep your shoulders still and move under control.

name: Plank Jacks
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet together.
Jump your feet out wide and back in, like a jumping jack.
Keep your hips level and your hands under your shoulders.

name: Plank Up-Down
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Press up onto one hand and then the other until you are in a high plank.
Lower back down one forearm at a time and alternate the leading arm.

name: Plate Halo
instructions: Hold a weight plate by its sides in front of your chest.
Circle it around your head, keeping it close and your core tight.
Alternate directions each rep.

name: Plate Pinch Carry
instructions: Pinch a weight plate in each hand with your fingers and thumb.
Walk for the set distance or time without letting the plates slip.
Set the plates down carefully.

name: Pogo Jumps
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bounce up and down quickly using mostly your ankles, with knees almost straight.
Spend as little time on the ground as possible.

name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding light dumbbells, arms hanging.
Raise your arms into a Y shape, lower, then raise them straight out to the sides in a T.
Finish by pulling your elbows back and squeezing into a W shape.
Move slowly and keep your chest on the pad.

name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
instructions: Set up in a push-up with your hands turned out and placed by your waist, leaning your shoulders forward past your hands.
Keep the forward lean and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up while holding the lean throughout.

name: RKC Plank
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with elbows under your eyes.
Squeeze your glutes, quads and fists hard and pull your elbows toward your toes.
Hold the maximal tension for short sets of 10 to 20 seconds.

name: Reverse Hack Squat
instructions: Stand facing the pad of a hack squat machine with your chest against it.
Release the safeties and sit your hips back as you squat down.
Push through your heels to return to the top.

name: Reverse Plank
instructions: Sit with legs straight and hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Hold for time without letting your hips sag.

name: Reverse-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells over your chest with your palms facing your head.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows tucked.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are straight.

name: Ring Push-Up
instructions: Set gymnastic rings a few inches off the floor and grip one in each hand in a push-up position.
Lower your chest between the rings while keeping them steady and close to your body.
Push back up and turn your palms slightly out at the top.

name: Ring Support Hold
instructions: Grab a pair of gymnastic rings set just above hip height.
Jump up so your arms are straight and the rings are at your sides.
Turn the rings slightly out, keep them steady and hold.

name: Rock Climbing
instructions: Put on climbing shoes and, for roped climbs, a harness with a belayer.
Climb the route using your legs to push and your arms mainly to hold on.
Keep your hips close to the wall and rest between climbs.

name: Roman Chair Side Bend
instructions: Lie sideways on a 45-degree back extension bench with your hip on the pad.
Lower your upper body toward the floor, bending at the side.
Lift back up past straight using your obliques, then switch sides.

name: Rotational Medicine Ball Throw
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall about a meter away, holding a medicine ball at your hip.
Turn your hips away from the wall to load up.
Rotate hard through your hips and torso and throw the ball into the wall.
Catch it and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Rucking
instructions: Load a backpack with a weight plate or ruck plate and tighten the straps.
Walk at a brisk pace with good posture.
Build up distance and weight gradually.

name: Safety Squat Bar Good Morning
instructions: Set the safety squat bar on your upper back and hold the handles.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

name: Safety Squat Bar Squat
instructions: Set the safety squat bar on your upper back and hold the handles in front of you.
Brace your core and squat down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up, keeping your chest tall.

name: Sandbag Bear Hug Carry
instructions: Pick a heavy sandbag off the floor and hug it tight against your chest.
Stand tall with your elbows squeezed in.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for the set distance.

name: Sandbag Over the Shoulder
instructions: Stand over a sandbag and squat down to wrap your arms around it.
Lap the bag onto your thighs, then explode up with your hips.
Roll the bag over one shoulder so it drops behind you.
Turn around and repeat, alternating shoulders.

name: Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Get into a push-up position with straight arms.
Without bending your elbows, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades pinch together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, then repeat.

name: Scorpion Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Lift one leg and reach it across your body toward the opposite hand.
Return and repeat on the other side.

name: Seated Behind the Neck Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with a barbell resting behind your neck, hands wider than shoulders.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower it slowly back to the base of your neck.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Sit tall and shrug your shoulders up as high as possible.
Pause and lower slowly.

name: Seated Hammer Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing in.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your back against the bench or upright.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Sit in the plate-loaded leg curl and lock the thigh pad down.
Curl the lower pad under the seat.
Return slowly.

name: Shadow Boxing
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands up by your chin.
Throw punch combinations at the air while moving on your feet.
Keep your hands back up after every punch and stay light on your toes.

name: Shoulder Tap Push-Up
instructions: Do a standard push-up.
At the top, lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder while keeping your hips still.
Place the hand back, do another push-up and tap with the other hand.

name: Shrimp Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg and hold the other foot behind you with the same-side hand.
Lower until your back knee touches the floor.
Stand back up on the working leg.

name: Shuttle Run
instructions: Set two markers about 10 to 20 meters apart.
Sprint to the far marker, touch the ground and turn.
Sprint back and keep going for the set number of lengths.

name: Side Plank Hip Dips
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Lower your hips toward the floor without touching.
Lift them back up above level, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Side Plank Reach-Through
instructions: Start in a side plank with your top arm reaching to the ceiling.
Sweep the top arm under your body, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back open and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with a light dumbbell in your top hand and your elbow tucked against your ribs, bent 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling while keeping your elbow pinned.
Lower slowly back toward your stomach.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with legs straight.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
instructions: Lie on your side and cross your top leg in front.
Lift your bottom leg off the floor.
Lower slowly.

name: Side-Lying Plate Neck Raise
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with your head off the end, holding a light plate on a towel on the side of your head.
Lift your head up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.
similarTo: Lying Face Up Plate Neck Resistance

name: Single-Arm Chest Press (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Sit in an iso-lateral plate-loaded chest press and grip one handle at chest height.
Press the handle forward with one arm until it is straight, keeping your torso square.
Return slowly and finish all reps before switching arms.
aliases: one arm hammer strength chest press

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent, holding one dumbbell with your upper arm resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbell straight up until your arm is fully extended.
Lower it until your elbow touches the floor and finish all reps before switching sides.

name: Single-Arm Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding one dumbbell at shoulder level.
Brace your core to stop your body rotating and press the dumbbell straight up.
Lower it back to your shoulder and finish all reps before switching arms.

name: Single-Arm Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit in the pec deck with your back against the pad and hold one handle with a slightly bent arm.
Bring the handle across in front of your chest by squeezing your pec.
Return slowly to the start and finish all reps before switching arms.

name: Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Cable Pushdown
instructions: Attach a D-handle to a high pulley and grip it with your palm facing up.
Keep your elbow pinned to your side and push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable and stand facing it.
With your arm straight, sweep the handle down to your thigh.
Return under control and finish all reps before switching arms.

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
instructions: Stand on one leg facing a low box.
Swing your arms and jump off that leg onto the box.
Land softly on the same leg or both feet, then step down and repeat.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding something for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise up as high as you can.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise as high as you can.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot planted.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips, then lower.

name: Sissy Squat
instructions: Hold onto something for balance and rise onto your toes.
Lean back and let your knees travel forward as you lower down.
Squeeze your quads to return to the top.

name: Six-Way Dumbbell Raise
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to the sides, bring them together in front, then raise them overhead.
Reverse the path back down to your sides.

name: Skater Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and foot behind you.
Lower until your back knee lightly touches the floor or a pad.
Drive up through your standing leg.

name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from rings or a bar with straight arms.
Tuck your knees and roll backward through your arms until you hang upside down behind you.
Pause, then roll back the same way to the starting hang.

name: Sled Rope Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a weighted sled and walk out to the end of the rope.
Sit back in an athletic stance and grab the rope with both hands.
Pull the rope hand over hand until the sled reaches you.
Walk it back out and repeat.

name: Sleeper Stretch
instructions: Lie on one side with your bottom arm out in front at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Use your top hand to gently push your bottom forearm toward the floor.
Hold when you feel a stretch in the back of your shoulder, then switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Behind the Neck Press
instructions: Sit under a Smith machine with the bar behind your head at ear level.
Unrack and lower the bar to the top of your neck under control.
Press straight up until your arms are extended, then lower again.

name: Smith Machine Box Squat
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you under the Smith bar.
Unrack and sit back until you lightly touch the box.
Drive up from the box without rocking.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Set a bench behind the Smith machine and rest your rear foot on it.
Unrack the bar and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up through your front foot.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
instructions: Set the Smith bar low and stand with the bar over your mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Stand up tall, then lower the bar back down with a flat back.

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
instructions: Set the Smith bar at shoulder height and rest it across the front of your shoulders.
Unrack the bar and squat down with your elbows high.
Drive up to standing and re-rack when done.

name: Smith Machine Good Morning
instructions: Set the Smith bar across your upper back and unrack it.
With slightly bent knees, hinge forward until your torso is near parallel.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return to upright.

name: Smith Machine Inverted Row
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about hip height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar slightly wider than shoulders and keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar, then lower until your arms are straight.

name: Smith Machine JM Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench under a Smith machine bar and grip it with a close grip.
Unhook the bar and lower it toward your chin by bending your elbows and letting them move slightly forward.
Press the bar back up to lockout.

name: Smith Machine Lunge
instructions: Set the Smith bar on your upper back and unrack it in a staggered stance.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front foot to rise.

name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on a bench under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a plate and the padded bar on your knees.
Lift the bar by raising your heels.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Unrack the bar and stand tall with arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, pause, and lower slowly.
similarTo: Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug

name: Smith Machine Step-Up
instructions: Place a box under one side of the Smith machine and set the bar on your upper back.
Step up onto the box with one foot and drive to standing.
Lower back down with control.

name: Smith Machine Sumo Squat
instructions: Set up under the Smith bar with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Unrack and squat down, pushing your knees out.
Drive through your heels to return to the top.

name: Soccer
instructions: Warm up with light jogging and passing.
Play a game or run drills like dribbling, passing and short sprints.
Rest and hydrate between halves or drills.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
instructions: Start in a standard push-up position.
As you lower your chest, bring one knee out to the side toward your elbow.
Push back up while returning the leg, then alternate sides.

name: Spoto Press
instructions: Set up as for a normal bench press and unrack the bar.
Lower the bar under control and stop it about an inch above your chest.
Hold briefly without touching your chest, then press back up.

name: Sprawl
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance.
Drop your hands to the floor and kick your legs back, landing with your hips low to the ground.
Jump your feet back in and pop back up quickly.

name: Squat Thrust
instructions: Stand tall, then squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back up to your hands and stand up.

name: Stability Ball Dumbbell Chest Press
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with your hips raised and feet flat on the floor, holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight while keeping your hips level.
Lower them back to your chest under control.

name: Stability Ball Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Rest your upper back on a stability ball with your hips up, holding dumbbells over your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.

name: Stability Ball Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on the sides of a stability ball with your legs straight behind you.
Lower your chest to the ball while keeping it steady.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball between your lower back and a wall.
Walk your feet slightly forward and squat down, letting the ball roll.
Stand back up to the start.

name: Staggered Push-Up
instructions: Get in a push-up position with one hand placed forward and the other further back.
Lower your chest to the floor and push back up.
Switch your hand positions between sets.

name: Stair Sprints
instructions: Find a long set of stairs and warm up.
Run up the stairs quickly, one or two steps at a time.
Walk back down carefully to recover and repeat.

name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Stand holding an ab wheel and bend to place it on the floor.
Roll it forward as far as you can while keeping your body straight.
Pull yourself back up to standing.

name: Standing Cable Row
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and stand facing it, holding the handle with straight arms.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your chest tall.
Pull the handle to your stomach and slowly return.

name: Standing Calf Raise (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Stand in the plate-loaded calf raise with pads on your shoulders.
Lower your heels below the platform.
Press up onto your toes.

name: Standing EZ-Bar Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Stand holding an EZ-bar overhead with a close grip and your arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your head.
Extend your elbows to raise the bar back overhead.

name: Standing Leg Curl (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Stand in the machine with one leg behind the pad.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

name: Standing Oblique Crunch
instructions: Stand with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee up and to the side while bending your torso to bring your elbow toward it.
Return and alternate sides.

name: Straight Bar Dip
instructions: Grip a single straight bar in front of you and press up so your arms are straight with your hips against the bar.
Lean forward slightly and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
Press back up to lockout.

name: Straight-Bar Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a cable and face away from the machine, holding the bar behind your head with your elbows bent.
Lean forward slightly and extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Bend your elbows slowly to return.

name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull
instructions: Take a wide stance and grab the barbell with a narrow overhand grip.
Drive up through your legs as if doing a deadlift.
As your hips extend, shrug and pull the bar up to your chin with elbows high.
Lower it back under control and repeat.

name: Supine Spinal Twist
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Bring one knee across your body toward the floor, keeping your shoulders down.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch sides.

name: Suspension Bicep Curl
instructions: Hold suspension trainer handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body straight and curl your hands toward your forehead.
Lower yourself back slowly.

name: Tennis
instructions: Warm up with easy rallies from the baseline.
Play sets or practice drills like serves and volleys.
Stay on the balls of your feet and recover to the middle after each shot.

name: Thread the Needle
instructions: Start on your hands and knees.
Slide one arm under your body along the floor, letting your shoulder and head rest down.
Hold briefly, return, and repeat on the other side.

name: Tiger Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Lower yourself until your forearms rest flat on the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms back to the push-up position.

name: Towel Pull-Up
instructions: Drape two towels over a pull-up bar and grab one in each hand.
Squeeze the towels hard and pull your chin up toward your hands.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Toy Soldiers
instructions: Walk forward and kick one straight leg up in front of you.
Reach the opposite hand toward your toes.
Step down and repeat on the other side.

name: Trap Bar Jump
instructions: Stand inside a lightly loaded trap bar and hold the handles.
Dip into a quarter squat and jump as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees and reset before the next rep.

name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand in a trap bar and lift it to standing.
With soft knees, push your hips back and lower the handles to mid-shin.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.

name: Triceps Extension Machine (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your upper arms resting on the pad and grip the handles.
Extend your elbows to push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly without lifting your arms off the pad.

name: Tuck Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and pull your knees to your chest.
Press the bar down toward your hips until your back is level with the floor.
Hold the position, then lower back to a hang.

name: Tuck Planche
instructions: Put your hands on the floor or parallettes with fingers turned slightly out.
Lean forward over your hands and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lift your feet off the floor and hold with straight arms.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing the bell up to chest height with straight arms.
Let it fall back into the hinge and repeat smoothly.

name: Typewriter Push-Up
instructions: Start in a very wide push-up position.
Lower down and shift your body toward one hand, straightening the other arm.
Slide across to the other side at the bottom, then push back up to the center.

name: Underhand Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at the cable row with a straight bar attached and grip it palms up.
Sit tall and pull the bar to your lower stomach, keeping your elbows close.
Extend your arms slowly to return.

name: VersaClimber
instructions: Strap your feet into the pedals and grab the handles.
Climb by driving one leg down while the opposite arm pulls down.
Keep a steady rhythm, using longer strokes for strength or short fast strokes for speed.

name: Vertical Leg Press
instructions: Lie on your back under the vertical leg press with your feet on the platform.
Release the safeties and lower the platform toward your chest.
Press the platform back up without locking your knees.

name: Viking Press (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Stand between the handles of a viking press machine, facing the weight.
Grip the handles at shoulder height and brace your core.
Press the handles straight up until your arms lock out, then lower under control.

name: Waiter Curl
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms flat under the top plate.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the dumbbell up to your chest.
Lower slowly.

name: Walking Knee Hugs
instructions: Step forward and pull the opposite knee up to your chest with both hands.
Rise onto the toes of your standing foot and hold briefly.
Step down and repeat on the other side as you walk.

name: Wall Angels
instructions: Stand with your back, head and hips flat against a wall.
Raise your arms into a goal-post position with the backs of your arms on the wall.
Slide your arms up overhead and back down, keeping them touching the wall.

name: Wall Handstand Hold
instructions: Put your hands on the floor about a hand's length from a wall.
Kick up so your heels rest against the wall.
Push the floor away, keep your body straight and hold.

name: Wall Push-Up
instructions: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place your palms on it at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall, keeping your body straight.
Push back to the start.

name: Wall Walk
instructions: Lie face down with your feet against a wall.
Push up and walk your feet up the wall while walking your hands back toward it.
Get as close to the wall as you can, then walk back down slowly.

name: Weighted Dip
instructions: Attach weight to a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet and support yourself on parallel bars.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

name: Weighted Plank
instructions: Get into a forearm plank and have a partner place a plate on your upper back.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Hold for time without letting your hips sag.

name: Wheel Pose
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, and place your hands by your ears.
Press into your hands and feet to lift your hips and chest into an arch.
Straighten your arms as far as you can, hold, then lower slowly.

name: Wide Chest Press (Plate-Loaded)
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the wide handles at chest height.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly, letting your chest stretch at the bottom.

name: Wide-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Hold an EZ bar on its outer bends with palms facing up.
Curl the bar to your shoulders, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Wide-Grip Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and take a grip clearly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar to your upper chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are extended.
similarTo: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip well wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, driving your elbows down and out.
Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Wrestler's Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet flat and hands beside your head.
Lift your hips and roll onto the top of your head, supporting yourself with your hands at first.
Rock gently back and forth, then come down slowly.

name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
instructions: Hold one arm straight in front of you with your palm facing down.
Use your other hand to gently bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds and switch arms.

name: Zercher Carry
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at waist height and cradle it in the crook of your elbows.
Stand up, squeeze the bar to your body and brace your core.
Walk forward with short steps for the set distance, then set it back down.
